verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a dedicated Sandbox environment you sign up for separately. It is used to mock flows, execute transfers and test integrations, and supports faucet-sourced test crypto and a Dashboard Fund button for USD and Paxos stablecoins, enabling end-to-end testing without production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox/production isolation (separate credentials, base URLs, data separation), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox works as described.
